thread:
incident-bot: Incident created — eu-west1 serving instability. Symptoms: autoscale oscillation caused repeated pod crashloops and CUDA OOMs on gpu-serving pools. Pager triggered: high error rate for generation endpoints. Severity: P1.

oncall-ml: I'm on it, taking pager. Will coordinate handoffs. @sarah @raj please chime in if you have immediate context.

sarah: saw the spike at 21:06 UTC. HPA spun up ~24 pods then collapsed to 3 in ~5m. Runtime logs show repeated `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` from runtime-worker.

raj: infra here. Could be aggressive scale velocity + short cooldowns. Share HPA/CA configs please.

lisa: observability: tokenized-gen route errors jumped to ~15% 5xx; p95 latency x3. Affects both dedicated and hosted customers in eu-west1. CS notified subset of heavy users.

mike: paste from a failing pod log:

```
runtime-worker-7f4b6b5c: 2026-03-15T21:07:12Z ERROR CUDA: failed to allocate 524288000 bytes: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/serve/worker.py", line 212, in generate
    kv_cache.load_batch(batch)
  File "/app/serve/kv.py", line 98, in load_batch
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()
RuntimeError: CUDA OOM
```

sarah: pattern looks like OOM -> container restart -> kube marks not-ready -> autoscaler reacts -> new pods also hit OOM -> cascade. Retry loops amplify load.

raj: immediate infra mitigations I can apply:
- set HPA minReplicas=3 maxReplicas=8 (was 1..40)
- add stabilization window / throttle scale velocity
- prevent rapid scale down with cooldown annotation

incident-bot: @raj assigned to infra. ETA 2m.

raj: patching HPA: `kubectl patch hpa tokenized-gen -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":3,"maxReplicas":8}}'`

lisa: I'm reducing router batch size and pushing a 20-25% fallback to quantized-cpu route to lower GPU pressure.

mike: routing change requested: `POST /controlplane/route {"route":"tokenized-gen","fallback":"quantized-v2","traffic_shift":25}` -> 200 OK

sarah: disabling LB retries for eu-west1 prefix to avoid retry storms.

ops: applied `retry: false` on edge LB for affected prefix.

infra-bot: node-pool autoscaler policy updated: max surge nodes = 8.

raj: after HPA and routing tweaks, pod restarts dropped from ~80/min to ~12/min over 3m. CPU/GPU allocation looks less contended.

lisa: customer impact: ~14 customers experienced >5% error rate; 3 dedicated customers reported 10-15m timeouts. CS has started outbound communications.

sarah: hypothesis: latest model image increased VRAM usage by ~0.6GB (weights + kv cache). Combined with aggressive autoscale and retry loops caused the brownout.

mike: confirmed: `redwood/model-v2:2026-03-14` shows ~20% higher VRAM usage vs `2026-03-10`. New attention-cache feature noted in release notes.

lisa: mitigation plan next steps:
1) pin affected pools to `model-v2:2026-03-10`
2) disable GPU memory overcommit on node template
3) add HPA scale velocity limits and longer cooldowns cluster-wide
4) add preflight "memory diff" check in rollout pipeline

raj: starting (1) — canary 10% then promote if stable: `kubectl set image deploy/runtime runtime=redwood/model-v2:2026-03-10 --namespace=serving`

deploy-bot: Deploy triggered by raj: rollout/runtime 2026-03-15T21:12Z -> canary 10%

sarah: canary plan: keep quantized fallback, throttle in-flight requests to 4 per pod to limit KV cache growth. If canary fails, extend window and rollback.

mike: applied HPA behavior patch: `stabilizationWindowSeconds:300` and scaleDown policy with 20%/60s step.

raj: HPA now `min=3 max=8` with 300s stabilization. Pushed change.

lisa: metrics: 5xx rate falling to ~2.1%, latency trending toward baseline, canary pods stable (near-zero restarts).

sarah: CS update: dedicated customers got ETA update. Ops to compile post-incident report.

ops: collecting timeline, error counts, affected customer list. Will have a postmortem draft in ~45m.

mike: short action list:
- sarah: keep canary 15m then promote
- raj: make HPA config permanent and roll to other regions
- lisa: add traffic-split runbook for memory regressions
- deploy-bot: block auto-rollout for model-v2 until memory tests added

sarah: handing off long-running infra follow-ups to @raj and observability to @lisa. I'll stay until canary promoted.

raj: creating infra ticket to increase default GPU headroom and add autoscaler amnesty for transient churn.

incident-bot: Status -> mitigated (partial). Monitoring for regression. Severity under review.

oncall-ml: marking for postmortem. Collect logs: `kubectl logs --since=1h --selector=app=runtime` and node GPU logs `/var/log/nvidia/driver.log`.

sarah: lesson: avoid wide-scale rapid scale-downs without cooldown. Watch model memory deltas in release notes.

lisa: tagging incident: oom, autoscale-thrash, model-regression, eu-west1.

mike: handover complete. Ping if anything regresses. :thumbsup:

customer-success: CS notes: 3 active tickets (#3421 #3422 #3423). Customers asked for ETA; given ~30-45m while we validate canary.
